title: AI FAQ
snippet:
On the Pro and Organization plans, AI chat and web search first use each member’s personal AI usage, a weekly allowance included in the plan. After that, and for AI agents in workflows, AI actions consume workspace credits based on the complexity of the task and the AI model used.

key.On a self-hosted instance, the built-in providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI) work on every plan, Free included. Set the matching API key (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, `MISTRAL_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY`) in **Settings → Admin Panel → Configuration Variables**, or in your `.env` followed by a server restart. The models then appear under **Settings → Admin Panel → AI**.Custom providers (custom endpoints, private gateways, OpenAI-compatible or local models, extra regions), added under **Settings → Admin Panel → AI → Custom Providers**, are currently complimentary up to 25 seats. Above that, an Organization plan is required. The AI section of the admin panel states where your instance stands.
